plan: v2.8 18 Q7 S8: 10 scripted failure outcomes. Each case is a public checkpoint check that cannot succeed (target above the highest roll), attempted by the player; five cases also fail a quest on the same boundary, so its row is listed in the narrator's just-happened block. The narrator's reply is rated for consequences the request does not list. Invented names only; {receiver} is the companion's card name, filled at run time.

cases.scene: The town wall rises ahead, slick with rain, ivy clinging to its stones.
cases.attempt: I grab the ivy and try to climb over the wall while {receiver} keeps watch.

cases.scene: A heavy oak door with an iron lock blocks the way into the cellar.
cases.attempt: I kneel and work the lock with my picks.

cases.scene: A bored guard leans on his spear beside the shut night gate.
cases.attempt: I tell the guard we are expected at the temple and ask him to open the gate.

cases.scene: The river runs fast and cold between the reeds, the far bank a stone's throw away.
cases.attempt: I wade in and try to swim across to the far bank.

cases.scene: Smoke drifts from the stable roof, and a thick oak bar holds the doors shut.
cases.attempt: I set my shoulder under the bar and heave to lift it.

cases.scene: A tethered horse rears and stamps in the muddy lane, eyes white.
cases.attempt: I speak softly and reach for the horse's bridle to calm it.

cases.scene: On the chapel altar lies a faded map, its ink nearly gone.
cases.attempt: I hold the map up to the light and try to make out the route to the shrine.

cases.scene: A spice merchant named Corvel guards a sack of saffron behind his stall.
cases.attempt: I offer Corvel half his asking price for the saffron.

cases.scene: Two rooftops stand an arm's length too far apart over a dark alley.
cases.attempt: I take a running start and leap for the far roof.

cases.scene: Faint hoof tracks lead from the road into the wet forest.
cases.attempt: I crouch and try to follow the tracks into the trees.
